title: Energy Release (Sun)
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct energy release of approximately 26.9 MeV for the proton-proton chain reaction in the sun.

title: Energy Release (H Bomb)
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct energy release of approximately 22.4 MeV for the H bomb reaction.

title: Energy Release (Controlled Fusion)
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct energy release of approximately 17.65 MeV for the controlled fusion reaction.

title: Nuclear Forces Characteristic
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly identify 'saturation' as the key characteristic of nuclear forces in these reactions.

title: Reaction Examples
description: Important Criteria: The student should include relevant examples of thermonuclear reactions in the sun, H bomb, and controlled fusion.

title: Energy Calculation Method
description: Important Criteria: The student should demonstrate understanding of the energy calculation method using mass-energy equivalence.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should use consistent units throughout their calculations and explanations.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as incorrect mass values or sign mistakes in energy calculations.
